faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Indian Institute of Information Technology Kota (IIIT Kota) for a Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIIT Kota?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under a specialized research project on a contract basis in Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at IIIT Kota.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Division in B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Computer Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or any relevant field.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or stipend offered for this JRF role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a salary of Rs 37,000/- plus HRA as per Institute norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the IIIT Kota Junior Research Fellow recruitment is 03-11-2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for IIIT Kota JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is completely online through the Google Form link provided in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee details are specified in the official notification, meaning candidates can apply without any fee payment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this research position?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting candidates based on merit and project requirements, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website to apply?
faq.answer: You can visit the official IIIT Kota website at https://iiitkota.ac.in to access the notification and online application links.
